text: alex: Quick heads up — I just uploaded the near-final blog draft and the demo video schedule doc. Need a short final pass on tone, CTAs, and the webinar/demo timing. Link: https://drive.redwood/launch-blog/1871234567-draft (please comment inline). maya: reading now. Quick ask — can we make the primary CTA a webinar sign-up instead of a demo request? Conversion is higher for that flow. sam: +1 to webinar CTA. Also we need to ensure inbound leads from the blog go to the "Launch Product" pipeline in HubSpot, not the general MQL queue. olivia: tagging legal for the demo video script — @lisa any concerns on the privacy callouts? we mention customer data flows in 1 line. lisa: skimmed script — we should add one sentence about no data retention beyond session, happy to provide exact phrasing. patrick: for the webinar CTAs, can we use a UTM template so growth can segment paid vs organic? propose: ``` ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch2026&utm_content=webinar_cta ``` Can someone add this to the CTA button hrefs? alex: good catch, Patrick — I'll stitch that in. Also deciding between "Watch demo" vs "Register for webinar" as the H2 CTA. Which reads better? maya: "Register for webinar" — makes action clear and helps list building. sam: agree. Also set form to ask only name + work email + company (no phone) to keep friction low. olivia: calendar-bot scheduled a 30m sync to finalize assets: calendar-bot: Event created by olivia — "Launch blog final review" Tue Mar 12 11:00-11:30 PT — Guests: alex, maya, sam, olivia, lisa lisa: approved the privacy line: "We do not retain personal data from demo sessions beyond troubleshooting and analytics; see our privacy policy for details." add link to /legal/privacy. patrick: growth flagged a small change — the webinar landing page needs a hidden field "source=blog_post" so we can auto-tag in HubSpot. We'll add that to the form embed. alex: note for devs — include this snippet on the CTA button: ``` Register for webinar ``` maya: visuals — header hero needs to be 1200x600 and match the product demo screenshot. I uploaded 3 options into the draft folder, pick one by EOD. sam: confirming HubSpot flow: form submissions -> property set "Lifecycle Stage: Lead" -> workflow moves to "Launch Product" pipeline and sends autoresponder with webinar details and calendar link. tagging @growth-team for operational check. olivia: quick microcopy tweak suggestion for the top blurb: change "fast, reliable inference" to "predictable, low-latency inference" — more specific claim. Thoughts? alex: i like that. makes the benefit clearer. changing now. patrick: tiny SEO note — include long-tail phrase "LLM inference latency optimization" once in the second paragraph. alex: added SEO phrase and updated CTAs + utm + form instructions. final ask: please react with :thumbsup: if approved or drop any blockers before the calendar sync. maya: :thumbsup: looks good to me. sam: :thumbsup: form & routing confirmed from my side. lisa: :thumbsup: legal OK. olivia: one tiny nit on hero crop but will fix in the meeting. :thumbsup: patrick: :thumbsup: tracking ready. alex: thanks team — will lock assets and hand off to eng for button deploy after the sync.
